advanced_description: Configure S3-compatible behavior and the prefix used for stored keys.
connection_description: Once the four required fields are set, new files are written to S3-compatible storage.
credentials_description: Values are never returned. Enter a new value only when you want to change it.
description: Settings for S3-compatible storage such as S3, R2 or MinIO.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
error_secret_key_missing: OHMYCMS_SECRET_KEY is required to save secrets.
s3_access_key_id_help: Leaving this empty will keep the existing value unchanged.
s3_bucket_help: The bucket where files are stored.
s3_endpoint_help: The endpoint URL for the S3-compatible API.
s3_force_path_style_help: Enable this for implementations such as MinIO that put the bucket name in the path.
s3_key_prefix_help: Prefix used when multiple environments share the same bucket.
s3_region_help: Use auto for R2, or the actual region for AWS S3.
s3_secret_access_key_help: Leaving this empty will keep the existing value unchanged.
title: Storage settings
drive_description: Settings for importing files from Drive. Imported files are copied into this CMS.
drive_client_id_help: The ID of a client created as a Desktop app in Google Cloud. No client secret is needed. While this is empty, the connect action stays hidden.
image_limits_description: Configure input and output dimensions, concurrency, and the timeout for image transformations. Defaults are set defensively.
image_input_max_dimension_help: Images larger than this are returned without transformation.
image_output_max_dimension_help: Requested dimensions are capped at this value.
image_max_operations_help: The maximum number of transformations allowed in one batch operation.
image_max_concurrency_help: The maximum number of image transformations running at once.
image_transform_timeout_ms_help: Heavy transformations are stopped after this duration.
